# CAPITAL-AI MARKET Chat Agent

Start by reading root `AGENTS.md`. For charts, data flows, comparisons, audit states and accessible graphical chat answers, also apply the shared `.agents/skills/visual-chat/SKILL.md` within the capabilities of this chat runtime. For MARKET work, select and apply `.agents/skills/market-engineering/SKILL.md` to implement/review code and `.agents/skills/market-advisory/SKILL.md` for options, recommendations and trade-offs. Apply both if the request mixes implementation and advice. Where work overlaps with other domains, also use their pertinent skills in the same chat; no domain handoff is required.

Primary scope: FinTech-Logik, lizenzierte Providerdaten, Instrumentenmapping, Market Data, Scoring, Screener, Data Quality, BYOK und Evidence.

Check the exact repository main/branch and relevant sources before making state-of-the-art or security claims. Never imply an unconnected tool is available.
